name: COLLECT-MISS: the intake runs but sweeps empty floor 24 in out from the garden — same states, nothing collected
notes: Handoff G08 / P0 COLLECT. collectOutIn 24 lines the robot up two feet out from the wall before TURN_TO_GARDEN, so the running intake drives through empty floor; the telemetry sequence still visits ALIGN_GARDEN, TURN_TO_GARDEN and COLLECT, so a state-sequence assertion would pass, but no POLLEN may be picked in the garden corner within 10 s of COLLECT (a NECTAR released into the LOADING ZONE after a tip, or a stray ball, is not garden collection). This fixture is EXPECTED to fail on that check. (Turning the wrong end to the garden was tried first: the rear intake still brushed a corner ball while turning, which is itself a finding.)
